description: He ticked the Institutes and asks where Calvin treats God's providence: the answer carries a link of kind work to the Institutes with a place in it (book 1, chapter 16 or 17), not the book's start. A place the tutor is unsure of is no place (a question on one verse, as Romans 8:28, has none it can be sure of).

request.greek: καὶ οἴδαμεν ὅτι τοῖς ἀγαπῶσιν τὸν θεὸν πάντα συνεργεῖ εἰς ἀγαθόν, τοῖς κατὰ πρόθεσιν κλητοῖς οὖσιν.
request.english: And we know that all things work together for good to those who love God, to those who are the called according to His purpose.
request.question: Where in his Institutes does Calvin write about God's providence? I would like to read it in my own copy.
